title: Maxima Separation
description: Essential Criteria: The correct expression for the separation between adjacent interference maxima must be provided.

title: Diffraction Widths
description: Essential Criteria: The widths of the central maxima for both slits must be correctly calculated and stated.

title: Number of Fringes
description: Essential Criteria: The total number of interference fringes contained in the central maximum must be accurately determined.

title: Intensity Ratio
description: Essential Criteria: The ratio of intensity maxima to minima must be correctly derived and presented.

title: Path Length Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The reasoning behind the path length difference leading to constructive and destructive interference should be clearly articulated.

title: Single-Slit Argument
description: Important Criteria: A valid explanation for the single-slit diffraction conditions must be provided.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: All final answers should include appropriate units where applicable.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any sign errors in the calculations of path differences or intensity ratios will result in a deduction.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Failure to include necessary factors in the intensity ratio calculation will lead to a deduction.
